recipe.visualDefinition: A high-key studio portrait of a young man with feathered hair, dressed in all-white 1970s fashion, positioned centrally against a stark white background that bleeds into a white grand piano on the left. The typography is placed at the extreme top edge in a thin, wide-spaced sans-serif.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's white clothing blending into the white background and piano
High-contrast black stripes on the sweater acting as a focal anchor
Extreme top-edge placement of text creating a large vertical void
Warm skin tones and hair contrasting against a cool, sterile white environment

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium shot, centered horizontally, occupying the middle two-thirds of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark horizontal stripes on the shoulders of the white sweater.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, moves down to the black stripes, then outward to the piano keys, finally rising to the text at the top margin.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white space surrounding the head and filling the upper third of the frame.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm browns and tans (hair and skin tones)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value, low saturation overall with localized high contrast in the black accents.
paletteRestrictions: Limit colors to white, cream, tan, and black

letterConstructionRules: High aspect ratio (tall and narrow characters)
characterSpecificRedesigns: Aligned to the very top trim line
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single weight used for both artist name and title, separated by wide tracking and spatial positioning.

candidateDirections.reason: Geometric precision and thin strokes match the era's aesthetic.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: ITC Avant Garde Gothic Extra Light

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-key studio portrait of a smiling young man with 1970s feathered hair, wearing a white button-down shirt and a white sweater with two black stripes on the shoulders. He is standing next to a white grand piano. The entire background is pure white, causing the white clothing and piano to blend into the environment. Soft, even lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase text in a hairline geometric sans-serif at the very top edge of the frame. Place the artist name in the top left and the album title in the top right, using wide letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Are the black stripes on the sweater prominent?
Is the text placed at the extreme top edge?
Is the font weight extremely thin?

adjustableVariables: Number of stripes on the sweater
Specific musical instrument (e.g., guitar instead of piano)
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original artist
Exact wording of the original title

mustAchieve: High-key lighting without blowing out skin details

postGenerationChecks: Check that the white clothing doesn't disappear completely into the background.
Ensure the hair texture is well-defined despite the high-key lighting.
Verify the text is legible despite the hairline weight.
Confirm the composition maintains a large amount of negative space at the top.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-key white-on-white studio portrait with hairline geometric typography placed at the extreme margins to evoke 1970s pop minimalism.
